action: General advice: POSTECH account holders should change their university account password and anywhere it was reused, and watch for phishing that uses their name or email.

evidence.quote: 20일 2차 공지를 통해 대학통합포털(Podium)에서 개인정보 2만5,551건이 추가로 유출된 사실을 확인했다고 밝혔다.
현재까지 확인된 개인정보 유출 규모는 총 4만5,529건이다.

exec: A South Korean university's portal hack grew to 45,529 leaked records, including names, emails and office extensions.
org: POSTECH (Pohang University of Science and Technology)
plain: POSTECH in South Korea says hackers who broke into its campus portals leaked 45,529 records in total, after it found 25,551 more records with names, emails and office extensions.
summary: According to Dailysecu, POSTECH said in a second notice on 20 November that 25,551 more personal records (names, emails, departments, positions and office extensions) leaked from its Podium portal, bringing the total to 45,529. Its first notice, on 19 November, said attackers used flaws in its research equipment portal (RETINA) and IT service portal (HEMOS) to gain administrator privileges. The attack was found after an illegal mining program turned up on a lab GPU server.
title: POSTECH says portal hack leaked 45,529 records in total after finding 25,551 more

validation.note: Single publisher (Dailysecu, two articles) relaying POSTECH's notices of 19 and 20 November; the notices themselves were not read. Dailysecu says 45,529 is the sum per system and the number of people may differ due to overlap.

review.note: Checked 19,978 = 19,500 + 478, RETINA/HEMOS, admin privileges, mining program, no ID numbers leaked, 19 Nov notice against Dailysecu
